core_question: Which climate resilience infrastructure segments offer the highest risk-adjusted returns for investment, and how can a China-UAE partnership deliver integrated solutions?
central_thesis: The storyline should be led by the strongest public evidence, then translated into management choices.
narrative_focus: Evidence is densest around: funding, timeline, market, adoption
structure_logic: Open with the executive decision, show source-backed data exhibits, then move through business implications, risks and action gates.

hypotheses_to_test.hypothesis: Dam safety and digital monitoring will see the most sustained investment due to regulatory push after the Guangxi reservoir breach.
Urban drainage upgrades in cities like Shenyang and Nanning will be prioritized with central funding, creating demand for smart water management.
Geological hazard monitoring (InSAR, AI) has high technical barriers and recurring service revenue, making it attractive for long-term investment.
Emergency equipment demand is cyclical and not suitable for stable returns, but mobile infrastructure (pumps, satellites) may have steady government procurement.
A China-UAE integrated solution combining drainage, slope monitoring, mobile pumps, satellite comms, and insurance models can be marketed to Gulf municipalities.

market_sizing_logic.formula: Total demand pool x serviceable segment share x reachable geography/use-case share
known_limitations: High-level market size can include demand that is not serviceable.

market_sizing_logic.formula: Potential customers x usage per customer x price/ARPU x adoption rate
known_limitations: Customer and price definitions must use the same scope.

market_sizing_logic.formula: Target customer pool x pilot rate x conversion rate x expansion rate
known_limitations: Early case studies may not represent scaled adoption.

market_sizing_logic.formula: Customer cost/revenue pool x improvement rate x supplier value-capture rate
known_limitations: Value-capture rate usually needs primary research.

market_sizing_logic.formula: Available capacity x utilization x unit price
known_limitations: Announced capacity is not the same as deliverable capacity.

charting_rule: Charts may use only evidence_ledger values, dates, source counts or same-unit comparable values tied to public URLs.
exhibit_narrative_rule: Every exhibit must be embedded in the section argument: prose sets up the management question before the exhibit and interprets the implication after it; never stack exhibits without prose.
